text:
samir: Heads up — main CI turned red after the pyright/dev-deps bump and a toolchain format change. Lots of type errors in the proto bindings and rustfmt diffs. PR I noticed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1482

ci-bot: Workflow "CI / check" failed on commit abcdef1 (branch: main). Logs: https://ci.redwood/abcd/123 — failing jobs: typecheck, pre-commit-format

alex_liu: On it. Can someone paste the pyright error lines? not sure if it's "module not found" vs stricter type rules.

maria_g: I'm seeing many "Incompatible types" in kvcache proto wrapper (pyright). Also rustfmt is producing diffs in eng-runtime/src/cache.rs after the bump. Looks like both tools got stricter.

jonathan_h: Quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally 2) bisect last merges 3) attempt small code patches or pin tool versions. Try `git show --name-only abcdef1` — suspect bump from 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 changed type narrowing behavior.

samir: Pasted a snippet from the logs:```
ERROR: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "Dict[str, bytes]")
  file: eng/proto/kvcache_wrapper.py line 42
  expression: None
```

karen: I can run a bisect now across the last 12 merges to find which merge introduced the combo bump. Starting `git bisect --term-good HEAD~50 HEAD` (will report back).

samir: :thumbsup: If bisect isolates a single merge that bumped both pyright and rustfmt, we can either revert that merge or do targeted code/format fixes.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by @karen — job queued: check (re-run for abcdef1). Build id: 788 queued.

alex_liu: Note: rustfmt diffs look like toolchain formatting change (rustfmt 1.6 -> 1.7). I can push a format-only commit to normalize.

maria_g: Can someone try `./scripts/ci-local-check --pyright`? I can reproduce the pyright errors locally with the new toolchain.

samir: I ran the local script and reproduced. Pyright flags typed-dict narrowness now — quick patch is to relax some concrete Dict[...] -> Mapping[...] in two places, or add explicit Optional[...] in assignments. I'll open a small PR for the typing change.

jonathan_h: Alternative: pin pyright in the GH action to previous minor until we finish patches. That buys time. Anyone opposed to a temporary pin?

alex_liu: I'm fine with patching code + format commit; faster if small. I'll do the rustfmt-only commit.

karen: Bisect result: offending merge is commit 3c4d5e6 (merge: bump/dev-deps) — it updated pyright and rustfmt in one go.

samir: Decision: land code typing patches + format commit. If CI still red, we'll pin pyright in the actions and revert the bump. @ci-bot cancel queued re-runs for old commits and prioritize the PR branch runs.

ci-bot: Cancelled queued runs for older commits. New re-run for branch pr-1490 started: job / check (build 789). Logs: https://ci.redwood/abcd/789

maria_g: Confirmed: after applying the typing changes locally CI passes `pyright` step. Waiting on the format-only commit to clear rustfmt diffs.

alex_liu: Pushed format-only commit (no semantic changes). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1490 (format-only).

samir: Thanks. Follow-ups: - eng-oncall keep an eye for related flakes - devex: update pre-commit docs about expected rustfmt/tooling pinning and how to run `./scripts/ci-local-check` - I'll draft a small rollback checklist in case we need to revert the bump quickly.

jonathan_h: Also add a short note to release docs: "dev-deps bumps can affect typecheck/format; run local check before merge".

karen: :white_check_mark: CI green now on the PRs after typing + format commits. Closing triage — reopen if anything else pops up.

samir: Thanks everyone for the quick triage and fixes.
